activity_summary: Richard began with the hay, which is dear. He took the bay. He gave Edmund's question and Joan's table before anything you would have asked. You did not make a speech on the bridge. The river is up. Anne and your mother are in the house.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Handed over the bay and kept the rest for walking.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the horse, began with the hay, and named the house as ready.

quotes.speaker: richard_shakespeare
quotes.text: Hay is dear. What is left of last year's.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Take him. The rest of the news can walk.

quotes.speaker: richard_shakespeare
quotes.text: I was told to watch the bridge, and I have, and you are what came.
